review.images: Nine native Nakheel renders from the official 50-page original-release brochure. The brochure and original source books state that reproduction or partial use requires prior authorization. Retain this material for local review and resolve reuse permission before Git handoff or publication.
review.location: Physical brochure page 8, printed pages 12–13, shows the six original-release journeys and distances. Its estimates differ from the current multi-phase construction page. The corporate short map link resolves to Rixos The Palm Hotel & Suites, so it is excluded. Directions use the original project’s full name and Dubai Islands location.
review.floorPlans: 323 complete original release sheets across six books. A1 has 65, A2 has 61, A3 has 101, A4 has 60, beach houses have 18 and villas have 18 options across nine numbered plots. Display totals match the printed sq ft column. Visual review resolves incomplete text layers and duplicate hidden values. Small differences between printed totals and rounded component sums retain the original total. Source notices and both floors of applicable layouts remain visible.
